intro: Raise adorable Critterlings, craft unique items, and create your dream farm.
description:
Welcome to Cosmic Coop, a cozy farming and creature-collecting game where you discover adorable Critterlings, grow crops, and decorate your perfect little world.

Tend your farm, discover new Critterlings, and craft decorations inspired by the creatures you raise. Each Critterling has its own personality and unique item drops, letting you design your farm in creative ways.

Unlock new decorations, collect resources, place homes, and create the perfect balance to keep your Critterlings happy.

Whether you’re farming, decorating, upgrading your home, or just watching your Critterlings roam the farm, every day on your farm is a chance to build something new.

With its simple controls, colorful art, and relaxing gameplay, Cosmic Coop is the perfect cozy escape for players of all ages.
